positioning: Managed restaurant bookkeeping, accounting, payroll preparation and financial review.
promise: A team to handle the restaurant finance jobs in your agreement.

palettes.name: Paper, stone & ink
palettes.role: Core neutrals and their mixes for surfaces, type and borders.

palettes.name: Ready gold
palettes.role: Only gold-to-paper tints and gold-to-ink shades extend the signature color.

semantic.name: Complete
semantic.use: Use a check icon and an explicit complete label.

semantic.name: Needs review
semantic.use: Use a review icon and a next-step label.

semantic.name: Issue to resolve
semantic.use: Use an issue icon and a specific explanation. Color alone never signals status.

compositions.name: Paper & gold
compositions.note: Paper, ink and gold are the primary identity.

compositions.name: Ink & gold
compositions.note: Reverse panels use ink, paper and gold.

compositions.name: Gold & ink
compositions.note: Use ink text on gold and its lighter tints.

compositions.name: Stone & paper
compositions.note: Neutral panels use only mixes of the core paper, stone and ink.

voice.title: Name the record
voice.description: Say which invoice, settlement or time record needs attention. Include the amount or date that identifies it.
voice.before: There are outstanding items on your account.
voice.after: Two supplier invoices from 29 September need your approval.

voice.title: Give the next step
voice.description: Tell the owner what to do, where to do it and when the work is due.
voice.before: Please review this when you get a chance.
voice.after: Approve the two invoices in your workspace by Friday, 2 October.

voice.title: Keep the scope clear
voice.description: Distinguish prepared work from approved work. Keep the owner’s decision separate from the finance task.
voice.after: Payroll is prepared. The manager needs to approve the amended hours before submission.

identity.name: Primary logo
identity.use: Website headers, client letters, invoices and email sign-offs. Minimum width: 140 px / 35 mm.

identity.name: Stacked logo
identity.use: Square covers and narrow placements where the horizontal logo will not fit. Minimum width: 110 px / 28 mm.

identity.name: Wordmark
identity.use: Small document footers and text-led placements where the full logo already appears nearby. Minimum width: 110 px / 28 mm.

identity.name: Logomark
identity.use: Workspace navigation, app icons, favicons and the back of a business card. Minimum width: 24 px / 6 mm.

identity.name: Badge
identity.use: Notebook labels, folder seals and square profile artwork. Keep the badge as a single supplied asset. Minimum width: 120 px / 30 mm.

identity.name: Badge XL
identity.use: Review folders, larger notebook covers and presentation cover panels. Includes the service descriptor. Minimum width: 240 px / 60 mm.

applications.title: Restaurant workspace
applications.description: A product application for sales, prime cost, reconciliation and the owner’s approval queue.
applications.usage: Use paper for the work area, ink for navigation and gold for key figures. Show a text status beside every colored indicator. Sample records are included in the prototype.

applications.title: Business cards
applications.description: Contact cards for restaurant visits. The front carries the full logo; the back can carry the logomark.
applications.usage: Scale the supplied artwork to 85 × 55 mm. Add a 3 mm bleed for print and keep contact details at least 4 mm from the trim.

applications.title: Letters & correspondence
applications.description: An A4 letterhead for review summaries, agreed next steps and formal client correspondence.
applications.usage: Keep the logo at the top left and the contact details at the top right. Use the subject line to identify the month and the task.

applications.title: Client invoices
applications.description: A service invoice with clear dates, line items, payment terms and an easy-to-find total.
applications.usage: Replace the sample client, invoice number, service lines and payment terms. Use the gold panel for the total only; keep tax and payment details explicit.

applications.title: Client emails
applications.description: A monthly-close update and email signature, with the requested action and deadline above the sign-off.
applications.usage: Lead with the task, name the records and give one deadline. The EML file embeds the logo as an attachment; edit the recipient and message before sending.

applications.title: Monthly review packs
applications.description: A printed cover for the sales reconciliation, cost review and decisions discussed with the owner.
applications.usage: Put the restaurant and reporting month on the cover. Keep sample figures out of live reports; replace them with the approved client records.

applications.title: Restaurant review notebooks
applications.description: A working notebook for site visits, supplier questions, payroll approvals and the next review.
applications.usage: Use Badge XL on the cover and keep the working title separate. The notebook belongs to the operations team; it is not restaurant guest-facing merchandise.

applications.title: Client review folders
applications.description: Document folders for the close letter, invoice and monthly review. The square badge identifies the pack; the stacked logo fits narrow cover panels.
applications.usage: Use the supplied badge as a single label. Keep the restaurant name and reporting period outside the badge. Set the folder dieline and bleed with the print supplier.
